import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import backlog
doc = backlog.__doc__ or ""
entries = re.findall(r"\n  backlog\.py dispatch .*?(?=\n  backlog\.py )", doc, re.S)
missing = [e.split("\n")[1].strip()[:60] for e in entries if "--max-budget-usd" not in e]
print("dispatch usage entries without --max-budget-usd:", missing or "none")
sys.exit(1 if missing else 0)
